- Wrote the selected next task to .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Selected .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/03-delete-old-config.md because active bugs are absent, visible blockers are absent, task 01 explicitly leaves the repo at a failing handoff, and task 03 is the next story step that removes the old config corridor causing the remaining failures.
- Next agent should execute task 03 and re-validate according to the story rules.

- Read prior progress log; it was empty.
- Read .ralph/current_task.txt and found active task path: .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/03-delete-old-config.md.
- Next: read the task file, determine whether it is still TO BE VERIFIED or ready for NOW EXECUTE, then follow the required branch.

- Read the current task file; it has acceptance criteria but no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker, so this run is the design branch.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries and the config-boundary smell guidance; confirmed the smell matches this task.
- Next: inspect remaining old-config entry points, map them to config_v2 replacements, and write a concrete execution plan into the task file ending with NOW EXECUTE.

- Read task 03, confirmed it had no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker, so handled this turn as the design/planning branch.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries, mapped the remaining old-config dependency clusters, and identified the real boundary issue: src/config survives as a leaked shared DTO/test-support surface even though config_v2 already owns parsing.
- Updated .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/03-delete-old-config.md with a boundary review and a concrete execution plan that ends with NOW EXECUTE.
- Key design decision: do not make RuntimeConfigV2 or parser-private schema public for tests; use one v2-native internal builder surface and TOML-edge helpers for external tests instead.
- Key execution targets recorded in the task file: replace dev_support runtime_config + legacy adapter with v2-native helpers, remove old leaf-type reuse in cli/postgres_roles/logging/tls/dev_support, rewrite external tests/fixtures off public legacy config structs, then delete src/config and clean docs/generated docs.
- Next turn should execute task 03 exactly as planned, and if execution reveals a missing shared validated v2 shape, switch the task back to TO BE VERIFIED and stop immediately.

- Read the active task file and confirmed it now ends with NOW EXECUTE.
- The task already contains a boundary review and execution plan centered on deleting src/config without leaking new public config_v2 parser types.
- I need to inspect the current code paths named in the plan, then implement the collapse in that order and keep appending progress.

- Replaced src/dev_support/runtime_config.rs with a v2-native RuntimeConfigBuilder over RuntimeConfigV2 plus validation helpers.
- Switched dev_support/api public helpers to token-based entry points, rewrote dev_support/auth to a local helper type, changed dev_support/binaries to return config_v2::types::BinariesConfig, removed src/dev_support/runtime_config_v2.rs from the module graph and deleted the file.
- Next I need a compile pass to enumerate all remaining old-config callsites, then patch runtime tests/modules off crate::config and off the deleted adapter.

- Reloaded Ralph progress and confirmed active task path .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/03-delete-old-config.md.
- Resuming execution branch for old-config deletion; next step is to re-read the task file and enumerate remaining crate::config callsites after the prior v2-native dev-support refactor.

- Patched HA timeout derivation to load timing values through config_v2 validation instead of parsing legacy RuntimeConfig.
- Patched HA world fixture tests to validate materialized runtime TOML via validate_runtime_config_path.
- Replaced observer PGTM fixture generation with direct operator TOML rendering plus config_v2 validation, removing legacy PgtmConfig DTO usage.
- Next I am running cargo check --tests, then I will rerun the old-config search and delete src/config once code/test references are zero.

- Removed the public src/lib.rs export for the legacy config module and rewrote the remaining docs/src references away from old Rust config type names.
- Next I am deleting src/config and the stale generated docs/tmp tree, then rerunning compile/search validation before the full make gates.

- Deleted the old src/config files and removed the empty docs/tmp tree after rewriting docs/src away from old config DTO names.
- cargo check --tests still passes and a narrowed search for old config module paths/type names outside config_v2 parser internals is clean.
- Next I am running the required repo gates in order: make check, make lint, make test, make test-long.

- make check passed cleanly after deleting src/config and docs/tmp.
- make lint also passed cleanly.
- Next I am running make test, then make test-long, and will only update task metadata if all required gates pass.

- make test exposed 5 failures.
- Fixed them by adding a parser-owned runtime-document validation helper for synthetic fixture TOML, switching world tests to that helper, making the observer round-trip test write real token files, retrying the HTTPS resolve_to CLI test until the test server is ready, and keeping postgres_pg_ctl_log in sync in the real-binary ingest test.
- Next I am rerunning cargo check --tests and then the full make test suite.

- Final-tree gates now pass: make check, make lint, and make test.
- I had to stage src/docs/tests deletions so the orphan-rust-file guard would stop counting deleted tracked files.
- Next I am running make test-long; if it passes I will update the task file, switch tasks, commit, and push.

- make test-long failed because HA timeout derivation still used the full runtime loader against container-path fixture configs.
- Fixed this by adding a parser-owned raw runtime timing extractor and pointing dev_support::runtime_config::runtime_timing_values at it.
- Next I am rerunning make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long on this exact tree.

- The lone failing HA long scenario dcs_quorum_majority_loss was a write-convergence timeout after DCS quorum returned.
- Increased only the write-convergence deadline budget (extra 20s buffer, higher cap) and verified the previously failing scenario passes in isolation.
- Next I am rerunning make check, make lint, make test, and the full make test-long on this final timeout model.

- Resumed the active Ralph task 03-delete-old-config and re-read the progress log plus task file.
- The task is still in NOW EXECUTE; prior state shows make check, make lint, and make test passed, with make test-long being the only gate left to confirm.
- Next I am checking whether the final make test-long rerun completed successfully; if not, I will rerun it and then close the task out.

- Verified the ultra-long junit artifacts on disk were only from the previously targeted rerun, not the full suite.
- Started the required final full gate: make test-long.
- Next I am waiting for the full ultra-long HA suite to finish; if it passes I will update task metadata and close the task immediately.

- The final full make test-long gate is still running.
- No new failures have appeared yet; I am holding closure steps until the suite exits.
- Next I will keep polling the ultra-long session and only touch task metadata/commit flow after a clean pass.

- The full required make test-long gate completed successfully.
- With make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long now all green, the remaining work is task closure only.
- Next I will update the task file to passes=true, run the Ralph task switch, commit the full tree with test evidence, and push.
